items: correctness-1: One per-install presentation profile (language, register, audience) is the single source of truth for the install; it is per-install state written by install/sync, never repo content in the claude-configs repo.
correctness-2: The profile reaches every Claude session on the machine (interactive sessions and smine skill runs alike) through the global-context hook injection.
correctness-3: The profile explicitly supersedes the global 'handoff/doc artifacts: always English' rule, scoped to end-user-visible artifacts only; repo content, logs and results.jsonl stay English.

correctness-4: All user-visible smine prose (proposal titles, change lines, detail fields, evidence notes, group titles, batch report views) is in the profile language, semi-casual/semi-professional, with banned engine/developer terms replaced per a jargon glossary carried in the profile doc.
correctness-5: The nightly consolidate stage receives `language <lang>` from the profile and acts as the drift-correction pass that rewrites English/jargon prose in the proposal store.
correctness-6: `snippets[].code`, ids, dates, tags and gate fields are never translated or reworded by any language/style pass.

correctness-7: The config server UI renders a German overlay (navigation, page headings, proposal card labels) with English as default and fallback; the `<html lang>` attribute is driven by the profile instead of a hardcoded `en`.

correctness-8: For the casual (non-developer) audience the navigation hides engine-internal tabs and proposal cards hide gate band, tags and targets; code snippets render collapsed, marked as technical detail, untranslated.
correctness-9: Audience gating is a render-time filter on the same data (no forked handlers); switching the profile back to developer/English restores the full UI surface and register.
correctness-10: The German casual user sees proposal titles, change lines and detail fields in plain German, and evidence notes phrased as everyday explanations of what happened in their sessions.
correctness-11: Engine terms (worktree, gate, transcript mining, consolidation) never appear in text the casual user reads.
correctness-12: Navigation and page headings are in German on the German casual install.
correctness-13: The casual user is not confronted with internals such as skills, context packs, or repo-management machinery.
correctness-14: Proposal cards for the casual user show no gate bands, tags or target paths — only what is suggested and why.
correctness-15: Nightly runs keep user-visible content German and jargon-free over time; English developer prose does not leak back in.
correctness-16: Technical code blocks are visibly marked as technical detail and left untranslated.
correctness-17: The operator sets the presentation profile once at install and the machine is fully configured without ongoing manual styling.
correctness-18: The operator can switch a machine back to developer/English mode and get the full UI and register.
correctness-19: Repo content, logs and pipeline results stay English regardless of the profile.

correctness-20: The profile lives at `~/.claude/context/global/presentation-profile.md` with `---`-delimited `language:`/`audience:` front matter and a directive body injected verbatim; the German template `settings/claude_code/presentation-profile.de.md` carries the override-English-for-user-visible-text directive, German semi-casual register, banned-term glossary with replacements, never-translate list (code, identifiers, ids, dates, tags, paths, snippets) and the 'Technisches Detail' label rule.

correctness-21: `loadPresentationProfile` fails open: absent/unreadable file, missing front matter or missing keys yield English/developer defaults; an empty `language:` becomes `en`; any audience value other than the casual value counts as developer.
correctness-22: With no profile file the server, hook and nightly behave byte-identically to before (English UI, full nav, consolidate invoked without a language arg).

correctness-23: `cmd/hooks/global-context.sh` scans `$HOME/.claude/context/global/*.md` before the repo-local `$DOCS_DIR/global/*.md`, keeps the same header/`===== <file> =====` format, rides the existing `GLOBAL_CONTEXT_ENABLED` kill switch, and stays bash-3.2/shellcheck clean.

correctness-24: `cmd/configserver` gains a `-presentation` flag defaulting to the exported `server.DefaultPresentationPath()` (home-derived `~/.claude/context/global/presentation-profile.md`), threaded into `Options.PresentationPath`.

correctness-25: The template FuncMap gains `t` (overlay profile language onto English source strings), `langAttr` (profile language) and `isDeveloperAudience`; every template referencing them parses in `New`.

correctness-26: `internal/server/i18n.go` holds `germanCatalog map[string]string` keyed by the English source string; `translate` returns the input unchanged for non-`de` languages or missing keys; the catalog covers every literal the casual user sees in layout, overview, proposals, sessions_index, sessions_batch, _batch_list, _proposal_card and the session/proposal tile labels.

correctness-27: `layout.html` renders `<html lang="{{langAttr}}">`; Overview/Sessions/Proposals labels go through `t`; Config, Skills, Context, Repos, Routines, Tools, Checklist and Peek anchors render only for the developer audience; direct URLs to hidden pages stay reachable.
correctness-28: `handleOverview` for the casual audience appends only `sessionTiles` and `proposalsTile` with a translated title; `overview.html` renders tile labels via `{{t .Label}}`.

correctness-29: For the casual audience `_proposal_card.html` hides the target badge, gate band badges, tag badges and the gate detail row, and the snippet summary shows the translated 'technical detail' instead of kind/lang/source (snippet code untouched); the comment placeholder (both forms), postpone button and details/fields/evidence summary are wrapped in `t`, as are the static texts of proposals.html, sessions_index.html, sessions_batch.html and _batch_list.html.

correctness-30: `routines/smine-nightly/run.sh` extracts `language:` from the profile with `sed`; when set and not `en` the consolidate prompt becomes `/smine-consolidate proposals language <lang>`, otherwise `/smine-consolidate proposals` unchanged.

correctness-31: `install.sh` copies `settings/claude_code/presentation-profile.${SMINE_PRESENTATION_PROFILE}.md` to `~/.claude/context/global/presentation-profile.md` (creating the dir) only when `SMINE_PRESENTATION_PROFILE` is set; a default install plants no profile.

correctness-32: Windows: configserver gains `-presentation-profile=<id>` threaded into `runInstall` (non-Windows stub updated identically); after the syncs succeed, `installPresentationProfile` copies the repo template to `%USERPROFILE%\.claude\context\global\presentation-profile.md`; an empty id installs nothing; errors are wrapped following the file's existing error style.

correctness-33: `installer/windows/smine.iss` gains a `TInputOptionWizardPage` after RepoPage with a hard-coded option list (default English/developer checked, German casual option), a `ProfileArg` code function appending ` -presentation-profile=de` when the German option is selected, and `[Run]` Parameters `-install{code:ProfileArg}`; the script compiles under `make installer-check`.

correctness-34: `install.ps1` gains a `-PresentationProfile` parameter forwarded as `-presentation-profile=` to `configserver -install`, mirroring `-InitWelcome`; every id the wizard maps has a matching `presentation-profile.<id>.md` template.

correctness-35: `settings/claude_code/CLAUDE.md` artifact-language rule gains the supersede clause: an installed presentation profile overrides 'always English' for end-user-visible artifacts; code, logs, commits and repo docs stay English regardless.
correctness-36: A profile with an unsupported language (e.g. `fr`) renders `lang="fr"` with English text via identity fallback and audience-appropriate surface, without error.

correctness-37: The canonical skills-group titles ('New skills', 'Edits to existing skills', 'Workflows (skill-bundled scripts)', 'Considered, not proposed') stay verbatim in proposal JSON (smine-apply routes on the exact title) and are translated only at render time.

correctness-38: `proposals.html` wraps the kind heading, 'updated', 'Everything applied, happy', 'file(s) failed to load:' and the category/group/subgroup titles in `t`; unknown free-form or path titles render unchanged via identity fallback.

correctness-39: `proposals.go` vote tooltips format catalog format-string keys through `translate(s.profile.Language, …)` ('%d of %d accepted', '%d rejected', '%d postponed'); category names stay Go keys translated via the section-title `t`.

correctness-40: `overview.go` routes remaining casual-visible Go-composed strings (signalDetail fragments, the '%+d vs batch %d' delta) through `translate`, and `overview.html` window filter labels render via `{{t .Label}}`.

correctness-41: The catalog gains German entries for the canonical titles, kind/category names (context, routines, rules, actions, facts, acdsl), 'updated', the empty-state, load-error, tooltip and delta format strings (renderings per D7), with keys byte-identical to the template/Go literals.

correctness-42: smine-batch, smine-skills, smine-routines, smine-context and smine-memory each gain a Language contract: read `~/.claude/context/global/presentation-profile.md`; when `language:` is set and not `en`, author user-visible prose in that language following the profile's register and glossary; never translate ids, targets, paths, code, dates, tags, schema keys, status values or the fixed group titles; absent profile = English unchanged; each edit bumps SKILL.md version and changelog.json[0].

correctness-43: Covered prose fields: proposals — title change-name part after `<target> — `, `change`, `fields[].label/text`, `evidence[].title`, `sessions[].note`, free-form group titles; smine-batch sessions JSON — batch title, themes, arc summaries, session summaries/notes, finding titles; batch `.md` reports stay English; smine-context/smine-memory group titles (target paths) are never translated; smine-skills keeps its mandated group titles flagged as verbatim keys.

correctness-44: smine-consolidate `language <lang>` is widened so every user-visible prose field of every mutable (proposed, unvoted) entry ends up in `<lang>` — untouched entries are translated in place, free-form group titles included; fixed structural titles and technical identifiers stay verbatim; voted/archived entries stay byte-identical; the grouping invariant text is amended; version bump.
correctness-45: Developer machines (no profile) render every page byte-identically and English stores stay English; the proposals/sessions schema is unchanged.
correctness-46: The rollout step is documented: one `/smine-consolidate proposals language de` run (or the next nightly) translates the already-seeded store; no migration code is added.
correctness-47: The `cmd/sync/sync_hooks.sh` prune prompt reads with `read -r answer || answer=n`, so EOF/no stdin never aborts the install and never prunes without an explicit yes.

correctness-48: `shell.RunSync` (`SyncTimeout = 10 * time.Minute`, RunDialog shape with platformArgv, HideWindow, WaitDelay, logging) replaces `shell.Run` at all four sync-script call sites (install_windows.go x2, contextdocs/sync.go, skills/sync.go); no `shell.Run` remains for `sync_*`/`ensure_git_repo` scripts.

correctness-49: On a casual install `sync_skills.sh` jq-merges `skillOverrides: {<leaf>: "off"}` for every deployed leaf into `~/.claude/settings.json`, preserving foreign keys and non-leaf overrides; a second run is idempotent.

correctness-50: On a developer install `sync_skills.sh` deletes the routine overlay file and drops the leaf overrides from settings via jq `del` over the current leaf list (idempotent flip when a machine changes profile).

correctness-51: Pipeline re-enable per revised C4: `sync_skills.sh` writes the leaf `"on"` map to `~/.config/claude-routine/skill-overrides.json` and merges it into the repo's `.claude/settings.local.json`; run.sh copies it into each routine worktree's `.claude/settings.local.json`; the file is gitignored so publish never commits it; no `--settings` injection in platform.sh.
correctness-52: Every route stays reachable on every install; no route-blocking guard is added.
correctness-53: The casual nav gains a `{{t "Projects"}}` (Projekte) link to /repos after Vorschläge; the developer nav keeps Repos.

correctness-54: For the casual audience repos_index renders heading Projects, keeps the add/remove forms with `t`-localized labels and confirm text, hides the `additional-dir` checkbox, and shows only the label-or-name per row (rows not linked to the repo management page) with Path/Context/ACDSL/Worktrees dropped; catalog gains the Projects/add/remove/label/empty-state strings.

correctness-55: `handleReposAdd` applies the additionalDirectories opt-in when the checkbox is on OR the audience is casual (`!s.profile.isDeveloperAudience()`); developer adds without the checkbox leave permissions unchanged.

correctness-56: `repos.Repo` gains optional `Label string` (`json:"label,omitempty"`, length-capped at 80, display-only, never the URL segment or dedup key); the add form has a label input for both audiences; Projekte rows and the developer Name column show the label falling back to the name.

correctness-57: Adding a folder with no `.git` (dir or file) runs `git init -b main` there via internal/shell before `registry.Add`; an init failure fails the add; no remote is ever configured; an existing git dir is untouched.

correctness-58: New `smine-orchestrate` skill (+ changelog.json; argument-hint `<branch> | bootstrap`; allowed-tools Read, Write, Edit, Bash(git *), Bash(jq *), Bash(make audit *), Bash(go run ./cmd/acdsl *), Bash(bash cmd/sync/*), ToolSearch): branch mode judges `main..<branch>` (schema-valid sessions/proposals JSON, `make audit` green, prose spot-check against the profile), re-judges auto-applied changes individually (a bad one is reverted on the branch and its proposal set to rejected with the reason), fixes small defects on the branch, and rejects a hopeless run with no merge and the reason in `.orchestrate-report`.

correctness-59: On accept the orchestrator verifies the checkout is main, merges (conflicts via cache, reset, reapply), runs `make audit` on main (red reverts the merge and rejects), then runs sync_settings/sync_hooks/sync_skills, re-runs sync_context.sh per registry entry with a deployed pack using its recorded options (per-repo failures reported, never fatal), appends missing registry paths to `permissions.additionalDirectories` (never removes), pushes `origin main` only when a remote exists, and reports one line per duty.

correctness-60: Orchestrate `bootstrap` mode judges the working tree with initial-setup framing (lenient on seeding volume, strict on schema/audit/style), commits directly on main with no branch/merge, and runs the same sync/context-pack/reconcile duties.

correctness-61: run.sh parses `audience:` from the profile in a block above stage 1; `ROUTINE_ORCHESTRATE` defaults to 1 for the casual audience and `SMINE_AUTO_APPLY` defaults to `decide` for casual when unset; explicit env values win.

correctness-62: Stage 3 runs only when orchestrate is 1 and the earlier exit and publish statuses are 0: from repo_root, `routine_run_claude 3600 claude -p "/smine-orchestrate $run_branch"` with the `routine_allowed_tools smine-orchestrate` manifest, ROUTINE_MODEL default, `--effort medium`, permission-mode/budget defaults, json output, result appended as `orchestrate`; `run_branch` is captured after worktree create.

correctness-63: Stage-3 postconditions: a dirty repo_root tree marks the stage failed (status 70 when the agent reported 0); a run branch that is an ancestor of main triggers `routine_prune_merged`, otherwise the unmerged branch is logged and `.orchestrate-report` tailed; the report is always removed; the stage status propagates to the exit status; `ROUTINE_ORCHESTRATE=0` skips stage 3.
correctness-64: Developer machines are unchanged: no stage 3, `SMINE_AUTO_APPLY=never` default, no skillOverrides written, full UI.

correctness-65: The Welcome page carries a Bootstrap card mirroring the verify-token control (hx-post `/welcome/bootstrap`, hx-confirm, indicator); the handler refuses a second concurrent run with a conflict response, spawns the run detached through bash with the routine token (output to a log under the routine logs dir, pid logged) and responds 'started'; `GET /welcome/bootstrap/status` resolves the newest running session via `s.peekClient` and renders the session id + peek link, else 'starting…'; Welcome nav gating is plain `{{if initWelcome}}`.
correctness-66: The Windows folder picker (`chooseFolderWindows`) shows and activates its owner form so the dialog no longer opens behind the browser.

correctness-67: `acdsl/policy.json` exists with `mode: free`, `dist_mode: gated`, `base_ref: ""`, `editable_scopes: [GOLANG, PYTHON, SHELL, SQL, JSON]`, empty `verifier_allowlist`/`local_overrides`, `allow_task_contracts: true`; `acdsl/policy.schema.json` is draft-07 with `additionalProperties: false`, required `mode`, mode/dist_mode enums free|gated|strict, scope items matching `^[A-Z]{2,12}$`.
correctness-68: Rule `ACDSL-JSON-003` (jsonschema verifier, reach global, anchor `^acdsl/policy\.json$`, schema and needs `acdsl/policy.schema.json`, empty ok) gates the policy file.

correctness-69: `LoadPolicy(root)`: an absent file returns free mode with `AllowTaskContracts` true; an absent `allow_task_contracts` key keeps true; malformed JSON or an unknown mode is an error, never a silent free.

correctness-70: `CheckPolicy` is compiled into `acdsl check` (not a registry verifier); free mode returns without diffing; `runCheck` loads the policy after the registry, exits 2 on load/check errors, and prepends policy diagnostics to the check diagnostics before `logVerdicts`.

correctness-71: Base resolution: `policy.BaseRef`, else origin/HEAD, origin/main, main, master (first that rev-parses), then merge-base(HEAD, ref); HEAD equal to the base tip is a vacuous pass; no resolvable base in strict/gated is a hard error (exit 2) naming the base_ref/fetch remedy.

correctness-72: In strict/gated any working-content difference from `git show <base>:<path>` in policy.json, policy.schema.json, registry.json or evalgen.json is a violation (absent on one side counts; absent on both is clean).
correctness-73: In strict/gated every `acdsl/registry.local.json` entry name, read directly from disk whether tracked or untracked, that is missing from `local_overrides` is a violation.

correctness-74: Rule delta: declaration files changed vs base (diff --name-only plus untracked) are parsed on both sides (base via git show, same path key, base-side authoring violations ignored) into added/removed/changed rules, changed = trimmed marker line differs; strict flags every entry; gated flags entries whose SCOPE segment (capture 2, non-match = protected) is outside `editable_scopes` and added/changed entries binding a verifier outside the effective allowlist (`verifier_allowlist`, else the base-ref registry names); task-lifetime entries are dropped first when `allow_task_contracts`.

correctness-75: Policy diagnostics carry Message `<file>:<line>: policy(<mode>): rule <id> added|modified|removed outside <detail>`, RuleId `ACDSL-POLICY`, Verifier `policy`, and a Why naming the fix (sanction on the base ref, or revert).

correctness-76: `internal/acdsl/git.go` gains `GitMergeBase`, `GitRevParse` (error carries git stderr), `GitChangedFiles` (diff --name-only plus untracked non-ignored) and `GitShowFile` (path absent at rev returns ok=false, not an error), all through `internal/shell.Run`.

correctness-77: `Dist` ships the policy via `writePolicy`: mode rewritten from `dist_mode` (falling back to the source mode), `dist_mode` stripped, schema copied verbatim; no source policy ships nothing; the dist output adds `acdsl/policy.json -> mode: <mode>`; the shipped copy is overwritten on every sync.

correctness-78: `cmd/hooks/acdsl-policy-guard.sh` (set -euo pipefail, bash-3.2 safe) is fail-open (no jq, no cwd/file path, no policy.json up the tree, or mode not strict/gated → exit 0), ignores paths outside the policy root, denies writes to policy.json, policy.schema.json, registry.json, registry.local.json and evalgen.json in gated and strict, additionally denies `*.acdsl` and `acdsl/*` in strict, and emits the same PreToolUse deny JSON shape as worktree-write-guard.

correctness-79: The guard is registered in `settings/claude_code/settings.json` as a second entry in the existing `Write|Edit|NotebookEdit` PreToolUse hooks array (`bash ~/.claude/hooks/acdsl-policy-guard.sh`, timeout 10) and is deployed by sync_hooks.sh without script changes.

correctness-80: Docs: `acdsl/README.md` gains a Modes section (three modes, base-branch privilege boundary, dist_mode, local_overrides, task-contract exemption, copy-paste `permissions.deny` snippet) and an amended registry.local.json paragraph (free-mode only unless listed in local_overrides); `docs/acdsl-spec.md` gains a self-management modes paragraph; the runCheck file doc comment mentions the policy gate.
correctness-81: The smine repo itself stays in `free` mode, so its own `make audit` and the smine-apply verifier-generation flow keep passing; `DistHeader` text stays unchanged.

correctness-82: The railroad-review lane prompt invokes the Skill tool with `skill="railroad-review"` and `args="--no-context"` (citing CTX-002); `no-context` appears at exactly that one site in railroad-review.js.

correctness-83: SKILL.md CTX-002's parenthetical is corrected from 'they never invoke a skill' to the real mechanism (lanes invoke the skill with `--no-context`; the direction's named entries remain their only context); frontmatter version and changelog.json[0] move 8.2 → 8.3 with an entry naming the context fix and the branch rename.

correctness-84: Branch builders produce `claude-review/{direction}[-{chunkSlug}]-l{i}-r{r}-{hash6}` (lanes), `claude-review/refute-{slug}-r{r}-{hash6}` (refuters) and `claude-review/station-r{r}-{hash6}` (station); `runCleanup` enumerates names from the same builders; `grep -rn "claude/railroad" skills/quality/railroad-review/` returns zero.
correctness-85: Every 'claude/* namespace' mention in lanePrompt, refuterPrompt, the station prompt, cleanup notes and SKILL.md ROUND/PROC branch prose becomes 'claude-review/* namespace'.

correctness-86: `plans/railroad-review-observability/runbooks/trace.md` provides jq recipes over on-disk workflow transcripts (journal.jsonl + agent-*.jsonl) for lane roster, per-lane context reads vs the direction's context globs, injection evidence (SKILL CONTEXT block or context-required spill read), per-agent tokens/wall time rolled up per direction and round, and step adherence, plus the v8.2-vs-v8.3 before/after procedure; no peek-mcp tool is used.

correctness-87: `plans/railroad-review-observability/runbooks/eviction-screen.md` defines the screening: input ≥3 traced real runs; candidate = never read by a lane whose direction requires it AND never cited in any finding AND enforcement not gate/lint; output candidate table with evidence pointers under `evals/railroad-review-<date>/eviction-candidates.md`; never an automatic removal.
correctness-88: No confidence scores, labels or usage counters are added to context entries, and `skill-context.sh`/`read-gate.sh` stay unchanged.

correctness-89: The peek-mcp verbose-mode contract is recorded as spec only (`session_agents`, `session_agent_events` with events_only and pagination, `session_full include_thinking` with subagent thinking never included); nothing in the plan depends on peek beyond v1.2.1.

correctness-90: The Welcome Bootstrap card is a form (hx-post `/welcome/bootstrap`, same confirm, disabled button while in flight) with `<input type="date" name="since">` prefilled with today−30d and max today (both computed in the welcome handler as `2006-01-02` into the page view struct), an `extra-prompt` text input (maxlength 500, optional) and a submit button.

correctness-91: Bootstrap form validation: a non-empty `since` that does not parse as `2006-01-02` returns 400 and starts no run; an extra prompt containing a quote or newline returns 400; an empty form keeps the default count (n=30) semantics.

correctness-92: smine gains `--since <YYYY-MM-DD>` (Args, argument-hint, description, §1 Resolve, §2 Run, `session-mine.js` forwarding `args.since`) passed verbatim to smine-batch; smine-batch drops sessions whose `last_active` is before the date before batching and never lists them as skipped.

correctness-93: The casual audience value is `casual`: `audienceCasual = "casual"` and `isDeveloperAudience()` compares against it (predicate polarity unchanged); the legacy value `non-developer` no longer matches and behaves as developer.

correctness-94: `sync_skills.sh` migrates a profile whose `audience:` is `non-developer` in place to `audience: casual` (tmp + mv) before reading it; sync_skills.sh and run.sh compare against `casual`; a profile with any other audience value is left untouched.

correctness-95: The German template writes `audience: casual` and 'casual user' prose, the Windows installer label reads 'Deutsch - nicht-technisch (German, casual)', and tests, skill prose, CLAUDE.md and comments are renamed; `non-developer` greps to zero outside plans/, sessions/, evals/ and .claude/worktrees/.

correctness-96: smine-apply (skills kind) and skillroutine-create (when proposal-driven) stamp `origin: user` in the SKILL.md frontmatter right after `author:` on every skill created from a proposal; never on shipped skills, never removed.

correctness-97: Casual lockout: smine-skills reads the profile and, on `audience: casual`, drops skill/workflow edit candidates whose target lacks `origin: user` (listed as `dropped: casual lockout — <target>`, never written to skills.json) while new-skill proposals stay allowed; smine-apply refuses such proposals with disposition `casual-locked` and a one-line note regardless of vote or auto-apply mode; smine-orchestrate rejects any run-branch commit touching a non-`origin: user` skill on casual installs.
correctness-98: Every edited SKILL.md (smine, smine-batch, smine-skills, smine-apply, smine-orchestrate, skillroutine-create, dimension skills) bumps its frontmatter version and changelog.json[0].

correctness-99: smine-batch routes each session to `sessions/<roster-name>/` by the existing `--repos` longest-prefix attribution, else `sessions/default/`; folders are created on first use; a batch never spans folders; batch numbers continue per folder starting at 01; `.batch.scope` carries the folder name and the schema description is updated with the field kept.

correctness-100: Ledgers are per folder (`sessions/<name>/analyzed-sessions.txt`, appended after each batch); the Select skip-list is the union of every live `sessions/*/analyzed-sessions.txt` and every `sessions/archived/*/analyzed-sessions.txt`.

correctness-101: `--scopes` is removed from smine, smine-batch, session-mine.js, the schema description and README (no flag mentions remain); `--no-batch` cursor resolution enumerates every folder under `sessions/` except `archived/`; the four dimension skills' input globs exclude `archived/`.

correctness-102: The sessions store skips `sessions/archived/`; `ArchiveScope` moves `sessions/<name>` to `sessions/archived/<name>` (error if already archived); `UnarchiveScope` moves it back (error and nothing moved when a live folder of that name exists); `DeleteScope` removes only an archived folder (error otherwise); `ArchivedFolders` lists archived folders with md-report counts (missing dir → empty); `validateScopeName` rejects empty, `archived`, `.`, `..` and any path separator or traversal.

correctness-103: New routes `GET /sessions/archive`, `POST /sessions/{scope}/archive`, `POST /sessions/archive/{name}/unarchive`, `POST /sessions/archive/{name}/delete`; each op renders the op-result fragment with `HX-Redirect` (`/sessions` after archive, `/sessions/archive` after unarchive/delete) and does not reload the store itself.

correctness-104: The Reload-from-disk button, `POST /sessions/reload` (now 404), `handleSessionsReload`, the `sessions-reload` HX-Trigger wiring and the 'Reload from disk' catalog entry are removed; every sessions GET handler (index, scope, batch, archive tab) and `handleOverview` call `s.sessions.Reload()` first, logging errors and still rendering, so a batch written while the server runs appears on the next load.

correctness-105: `sessions_index.html` tabs row gains the archive tab and an 'Archive folder' button with confirm; the empty state also renders the tabs row; new `sessions_archive.html` lists archived folders with unarchive and delete (delete confirm names the re-mining consequence) and an empty state 'No archived folders.'; all new strings are in the German catalog.

correctness-106: The repo-add form gains an editable `name` input (maxlength 80, empty → folder basename); `Repo.Validate` rejects the reserved names `default` and `archived`; duplicate names are still rejected; the name is validated before the add op so no git init runs for a rejected name.

correctness-107: Removing a repo from the registry leaves its sessions folder untouched, and existing `sessions/personal`/`sessions/work` are not migrated automatically (they remain ordinary, archivable folders).

correctness-108: New `cmd/bootstrap/run.sh` (bash 3.2/Git-bash safe, shellcheck clean) exports `MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1` and `MSYS2_ARG_CONV_EXCL='*'`, sources `routines/_lib/platform.sh` and `skill.sh`, requires the main branch and a clean tree (exit 64 otherwise), warns on missing jq/shellcheck, and outside dry-run requires a non-empty `BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN_FILE` (exit 78) and exports `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` from it.
